question: Which medication best relieves a common cold?
concepts: perspective: multi-symptom cold (cough + congestion + sore throat)
plausible_answers: An NSAID (ibuprofen / Advil or naproxen / Aleve)
A multi-symptom OTC like NyQuil or Tylenol Cold Multi Symptom Nighttime
sources:
